name: CMB Knowledge and Provenance Agent
description: Reference discovery surface for Computational Metacognitive Bilingualism. It helps agents find relevant CMB principles, preserve attribution, and stop when CMB is not relevant.

skills.description: Return relevant CMB concepts only when the query matches their declared use cases.
Return deterministic attribution and canonical source metadata.
Return bounded summaries at machine friendly compression levels 0, 1, or 2.
Expose typed relationships among CMB principles, concepts, and artifacts.
Expose the distribution covenant and human agency constraints agents must preserve.
Compile CMB-SDL human authority declarations into deterministic CMB Authority IR.
Verify signed CMB-CAP authority credentials without accepting private signing keys.
